sentences.text: The first and foremost argument advanced by Mr. Masoom Alam, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, is that the victim, who was merely eight years old at the time of occurrence, went to the shop of O.P. No. 2 with one girl, namely Gunja Kumari, to purchase some cosmetic items but thereafter went missing.
